selected_script.angle: Harsh chemical degreasers leave toxic fumes on food prep surfaces like kitchen islands; Liapu cuts heavy grease fast with a natural lemon scent, zero residue, and 99.9% antibacterial action.
selected_script.hook: I hated using harsh chemical degreasers where my kids eat because of the toxic smell.

script_record.segment_01: I hated using harsh chemical degreasers where my kids eat because of the toxic smell. But this greasy island needed something strong.
script_record.segment_02: Then I found Liapu. You just spray this heavy-duty degreaser and wipe. It cuts right through the oil without any chemical fumes.
script_record.segment_03: It leaves zero residue, smells like fresh lemons, and kills 99.9% of bacteria. This is a game changer for food prep areas.
